"''Oh, nothing serious, just a small malfunction.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, right before a starfighter malfunction renders the former unconscious|}} The '''defense of Cato Neimoidia''' took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], in the final [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] invaded [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] and major base of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Despite the planet's ties to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] through secret Trade Federation dealings, the Republic launched a defense of the former [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]], with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], commanding an assault force from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. While a fleet from the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Space warfare/Legends|held off]] the Separatist [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Skywalker and Tano [[Starfighter combat/Legends|breached]] the enemy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|aerial defenses]] with an escort of [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], clearing the way for [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and his 501st [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] aboard. They then moved in to engage the [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] that the Confederate fleet, which was occupying the Neimoidian [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]], deployed. Both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were separated from their squadron when a swarm of [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]] [[Saboteur/Legends|disabled]] Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|starfighter]], forcing Tano to stage a mid-air rescue of her Master before his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crashed. While the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] continued its efforts to repel the Separatists, Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] recalled Skywalker and Tano from Cato Neimoidia to investigate a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|You forget yourself, Clovis. You cannot threaten me on my ''own planet''.''"
"''This is hardly your planet anymore, not since you signed your holdings over to the Banking Clan in return for a stake in this new droid foundry.|Senators Lott Dod and Rush Clovis conspire on Cato Neimoidia|{{TCW|Senate Spy}}}} [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], a former [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]],{{FactFile2014|7|HEA 1-2|Z-95 Headhunter}} served as a major holding of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],{{DB|location|catoneimoidia|Cato Neimoidia}} which claimed [[Commerce Treaty of 1647/Legends|neutrality]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}} [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], the Trade Federation's [[Senator/Legends|delegate]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]], maintained a [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on Cato Neimoidia, from where he conducted dealings with the Separatists, isolated from the scrutiny of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. As a result of one such contract''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],{{FactFile2014|8|21 BBY 1-2|The Second Battle of Geonosis}} Dod and the Federation elite were forced to sign over their assets—allegedly, Cato Neimoidia itself—to another pro-Separatist megacorporation, the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], in exchange for a share in a new Confederate [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|battle droid foundry]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[File:Separatists_over_Cato_Neimoidia.png|thumb|left|250px|A Separatist fleet invades Cato Neimoidia.]] Although Dod's deal with Banking Clan Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] collapsed when the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundry,{{TCW|Weapons Factory}} the Clone Wars eventually engulfed Cato Neimoidia itself. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the final [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of fighting, the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] mounted an invasion of Cato Neimoidia, which—through the Trade Federation—was still part of the Republic, in spite of the Separatist ties held by Dod and [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. In response, the Republic and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] mobilized the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to stage a defense of the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. ==The defense== {{Quote|Are you okay, Master?''"
"''Yeah, what'd I miss?''"
"''Oh, not much.''"
"''Wait a minute, wasn't I flying? Where's my fighter? How did I ''get'' here?''"
"''Fighter crashed. I saved the day. You're welcome.|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker|}} [[File:InterceptorsSoar-S.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Tano launch from the Republic fleet with their starfighter squadron.]] By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Skywalker's [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] reached the [[Cato Neimoidia system/Legends|Cato Neimoidia system]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} the Separatists had divided their defenses between the surface and [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Three [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] and a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] occupied one of Cato Neimoidia's [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]], while another trio of [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] were saved for orbital support. In response, Skywalker had the three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] of his task force remain in orbit to [[Space warfare/Legends|engage]] the enemy frigates stationed there. While the opposing fleets exchanged [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]], Skywalker and Tano boarded their [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]], leading a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]–[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|Z-95 starfighters]] to provide escort for their ground forces, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. With Rex and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] following in six [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], Skywalker and Tano worked with their [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] to clear a path for the [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[Starfighter combat/Legends|blasting through]] groups of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] that the Confederate frigates launched. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led squadron breached the droid aerial defenses and entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], heading to assault the ''Providence''-class [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]/[[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] and the three frigates flanking it. As Skywalker, Tano, and their [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] approached the Separatist fleet occupying the bridge [[City/Legends|cities]], the ''Providence''-class destroyer deployed several squadrons of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] in retaliation. The tri-fighters swarmed the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] pilots from behind and shot down several of their Z-95 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] before moving in on Skywalker and Tano. The two of them evaded the tri-fighters' [[Discord missile/Legends|discord missiles]] but fell prey to the [[Missile/Legends|munitions']] contents: [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|Pistoeka sabotage droids]], more commonly known as "buzz droids." While Tano and her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] co-pilot, [[R7-A7/Legends|R7-A7]], escaped the buzz droids unscathed, a number of the [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] droids landed on Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|starfighter]], quickly getting to work doing as much damage as possible with their [[Circular saw/Legends|buzz saws]]. Skywalker's [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], smashed a buzz droid with one of the solar panels, while the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] himself used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] repel the rest of the saboteurs within sight. Unbeknownst to Skywalker, the majority of the buzz droids had crawled onto the underside of his starfighter, drilling into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and sparking an explosion that knocked him unconscious. The blast also compromised the [[Engine/Legends|engines]], preventing R2-D2 from flying the starfighter back to Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Tano pursued her Master's starfighter, with their flight path separating them from the rest of their squadron. With Skywalker in trouble, Tano told R2-D2 to land on an approaching cliff ledge while she resorted to staging a mid-air rescue attempt. Having R7-A7 match her [[Ahsoka Tano's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|own starfighter's]] speed with that of Skywalker's, Tano jumped ship just as R2-D2 crashed his starfighter onto the cliff, crushing the buzz droids underneath. With the long drop at the opposite edge of the plateau drawing near, Tano activated her [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber shoto]] and sliced open the cockpit, dragging out the still-inert Skywalker and pulling him to safety. R2-D2 ejected from his [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech socket]] before the starfighter careened over the edge to its destruction many [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below; the astromech droid joined Skywalker and Tano back on the cliff face. [[File:TanoRescuesMaster-S.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tano prepares to rescue Skywalker from his malfunctioning starfighter.]] After Skywalker regained consciousness, Tano reported her actions to her Master, as he had been comatose throughout the entire incident. Skywalker contacted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to request a retrieval, and Rex had his gunship, the [[Lucky Lekku/Legends|''Lucky Lekku'']], and the rest of his 501st troop [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] adjust course for their position. The Republic's assault continued without the leadership of Skywalker and Tano, with their task force's [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] moving in to provide support amidst the bridge cities. One of the Separatists' ''Munificent''-class frigates was crippled as a result of the Republic's efforts. Several bridge cities also suffered damage, with [[Fire/Legends|fires]] erupting amidst the canopies. While waiting for Rex's arrival, Skywalker and Tano received a high-priority [[holograph]]ic message from Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who informed them that the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had been [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombed]]. Despite Skywalker and Tano's ongoing efforts on Cato Neimoidia, Yoda recalled them to Coruscant to assist in the investigation of the bombing. Rex eventually returned to Coruscant with them as well. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Return to the Jedi Temple quickly, you should. You and your Padawan.''"
"''We're kind of busy, Master Yoda.''"
"''The reason we need ''you'', important it is, Skywalker. Bombed the Temple Hangar someone has. Your assistance to find the terrorist, we need.|Yoda withdraws Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan from Cato Neimoidia during the battle|}} [[File:JediAndRusso-S.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Tano begin their new assignment with [[Analysis droid/Legends|analysis droid]] [[Russo-ISC/Legends|Russo-ISC]].]] Upon Skywalker and Tano's return to Coruscant, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] assigned them to lead the investigation of the bombing in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. As the Trade Federation's ties to the Republic eroded over time, the Neimoidians fortified their defenses of Cato Neimoidia, doubling the conscription rate of the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions]] and installing other countermeasures in preparation for potential Republic reprisals. Such action came a few months later, when the Grand Army launched a campaign against the Neimoidian pursue worlds. As part of those efforts, Skywalker returned to Cato Neimoidia with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], overseeing an [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|assault]] on [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] Nute Gunray's [[Nute Gunray's citadel|citadel]] to apprehend him and the rest of the Trade Federation elite. Although Gunray and his staff escaped, the Republic captured Cato Neimoidia from the Neimoidians.''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' Nevertheless, scattered pockets of resistance [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|thwarted]] total Republic control.{{Film|III}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We wanted to challenge her, so the opening sequence in the first part of the arc shows her flying toward Cato Neimoidia and the action is all about showing her in her prime, and how she is now capable. Anakin shouldn't have to worry about her, because she's the one that saves him. She has a bit of an edge to her, not unlike Anakin.|Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]], describing how the battle sets up Ahsoka Tano as the protagonist of the Season Five finale arc|{{InsiderCite|140|Unexpected Journeys}}}} The defense of Cato Neimoidia was created as the opening act of "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series that aired on [[February 9]], [[2013]]. The episode served to establish the character of Ahsoka Tano as the protagonist of the following four-part story arc that ended the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. Prior to the release of "Sabotage," scenes from the battle were initially previewed in a trailer for the fifth season that was featured at the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration VI]] convention in [[August]] [[2012]].{{SW|url=video/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-5-trailer|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season 5 Trailer}} An entry for the buzz droid on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] was the first publication to reference the events on Cato Neimoidia.{{SWE|technology|buzz-droid|buzz droids}} The battle showcased the series' debut of the Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor, made famous notably by the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
